traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet intensity. All-or-nothing attraction, deep desire, and a strong pull toward control in relationships. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Power struggles, jealousy, and treating happiness as a kind of vulnerability to be guarded against. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for connection against power, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the connection/power form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Magnetic and persuasive; the intensity has to be moderated.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: When keeping the relationship starts requiring you to give up your ability to say no, the issue is no longer how much you love each other. When Venus squares Pluto, attachment can become tangled with money, guilt, jealousy, privacy, access, or the fear of what you will lose if you stop cooperating, making control easier to disguise as proof that the bond is important. Deep feelings do not make coercion more romantic. Notice which compromises come from genuine desire and which ones you are making because protecting your autonomy suddenly feels more expensive than protecting the connection.
